[2026-09-03T00:00:53.674Z] [world] You walk east through open silt. The compass tells you Tartarian Pilgrim Camp lies further east — 1 tile, about 3 hours of travel.
[2026-09-03T00:00:53.675Z] [world] A blast door, half-buried, the steel still warm to the touch even in the cold. It opens with effort. Inside: a sealed pre-flood bunker. Emergency lights still throb on a slow pulse. Cots, sealed crat
es, a wall map with cities still labeled by their original names. Whoever lived down here did not run out of supplies. They ran out of reasons.
[2026-09-03T00:00:53.675Z] [world] On the central desk: a logbook in three different hands. The final entry, written calmly: 'It keeps pointing at the Cradle. None of us have argued with it for weeks. Tomorrow we walk.'
